column1: # go-test-weights.tsv - per-package `go test -race` wall-clock, in seconds.

# Consumed by scripts/ci/go-test-shards.sh to balance the CI shards. These
# weights are a HEURISTIC ONLY: a package missing here is simply assumed cheap,
# and a stale number costs balance, never correctness - the package universe is
# recomputed from `go list` on every run and `go-test-shards.sh check` fails the
# job if any package would go unrun.
